memories.content: The McCain campaign has received an invitation to the first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed participation. They are considering the terms and logistics.

The Commission on Presidential Debates has scheduled the first presidential debate for September 26, 2008, at the University of Mississippi. Both campaigns have been formally invited. Public confirmation of participation is expected before the debate date. The debate is a major media event.
